governing_document: UP Model Building Byelaws & Uttar Pradesh Energy Conservation Building Code (UPECBC)
authority: Housing and Urban Planning Department, Govt of Uttar Pradesh
climate_adaptations: Composite climate standards: summer extreme heatwave mitigation and winter cold wave thermal retention.

rules.description: Opaque exterior walls must not exceed U-value of 0.60 W/m²K to prevent peak summer heat conduction and winter heat loss.
rules.remediation: Specify AAC blocks, hollow clay blocks, or external insulation on masonry.
